name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
summary: In Tarren Mill, Christoph Jeffcoat is trying to prove the Forsaken can cook with care. He needs snapjaw meat from Hillsbrad's waterways and the shores of Lordamere Lake for his turtle bisque.

sections.title: Forsaken Gastronomy
sections.body: Many believe the Forsaken have left the comforts of life behind, including fine cooking. Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill rejects that belief. He boasts that his rich turtle bisque could tempt souls back from beyond the grave. Through careful cooking, he means to show that undead hands can still make a warming dish in a land marked by plague and war.

sections.title: Hunting the Snapjaws
sections.body: Jeffcoat once gathered ingredients himself from Hillsbrad's waterways and Lordamere Lake's eastern shores in neighboring Alterac. Duties in Tarren Mill and nearby Alliance forces keep him from hunting. He depends on passing Horde cooks to hunt snapjaws, bring back their meat, and keep the recipe alive.

faq.q: Why does a Forsaken cook care about making hot bisque?
faq.answer: The Forsaken do not need food as living mortals do, but Christoph Jeffcoat takes pride in his craft. He wants to show that the undead can cook with skill, and jokes that his broth could bring the dead back to life.

faq.q: Where can turtle meat be found for this recipe?
faq.answer: Snapjaw meat comes from the aggressive turtles along Hillsbrad Foothills' rivers, in Alterac, and on the shores of Lordamere Lake.

faq.q: Why can't Christoph Jeffcoat gather his own ingredients?
faq.answer: Jeffcoat says his duties in Tarren Mill keep him occupied. Nearby Alliance forces also make his own hunting trips more dangerous.

faq.q: Is cooking knowledge required to take this quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Christoph Jeffcoat shares his recipe only with cooks, and no advanced skill is needed to begin.

faq.q: What is Tarren Mill's importance to the Horde in Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: Tarren Mill is the Horde's main stronghold in Hillsbrad Foothills. Once a human village, it is now a fortified base for the Forsaken and their allies, facing frequent clashes with Southshore and the Alliance nearby.

faq.q: Is turtle bisque unique to the Horde?
faq.answer: Alliance cooks can learn a turtle bisque recipe from human chefs in Southshore, who also use local turtles. Christoph Jeffcoat's personal request and outlook belong to the Horde.

angles.text: As a cook, you can learn to make Soothing Turtle Bisque from the snapjaws of Lordamere Lake and Hillsbrad's rivers.
As an undead, you can see Christoph Jeffcoat's passion for cooking, which death has not dulled.
As a member of the Horde, you help Tarren Mill by keeping its provisions and morale strong, alongside defending its borders.
